title: AS2 -- Attention-Based Soft Answer Sets: An End-to-End Differentiable Neuro-Soft-Symbolic Reasoning Architecture
abstract: arXiv:2603.18436v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neuro-symbolic systems typically combine neural perception with discrete symbolic solvers, limiting end-to-end optimization. We introduce Attention-Based Soft Answer Sets (AS$^2$), a fully differentiable neuro-symbolic architecture that replaces discrete solving with a continuous approximation of the Answer Set Programming (ASP) immediate-consequence operator $T_P$. AS$^2$ maintains probability distributions over finite symbol domains and learns by minimizing the fixed-point residual of a probabilistic version of $T_P$, enabling differentiation through constraint checking without external solvers during training or inference. For spatial constraint-satisfaction tasks, AS$^2$ replaces positional embeddings with constraint-group membership embeddings derived directly from declarative ASP specifications, making the model independent of arbitrary position indexing. On Visual Sudoku, AS$^2$ achieves 99.89% raw cell accuracy and 100% const

translated_title: AS²——基于注意力的软答案集：一种端到端可微分的神经-软-符号推理架构
translated_abstract: 神经符号系统通常将神经感知与离散符号求解器相结合，这限制了端到端优化。我们提出了基于注意力的软答案集（AS²），这是一种完全可微分的神经符号架构，它用答案集编程（ASP）立即后果算子 $T_P$ 的连续近似取代了离散求解。AS² 在有限符号域上维护概率分布，并通过最小化概率化 $T_P$ 的不动点残差来进行学习，从而在训练和推理过程中无需外部求解器即可对约束检查进行梯度传播。对于空间约束满足任务，AS² 用直接从声明式 ASP 规范导出的约束组归属嵌入取代位置嵌入，使模型摆脱了对任意位置索引的依赖。在视觉数独任务上，AS² 实现了 99.89% 的原始单元格准确率和 100% 的约束满足率。
tldr: AS²提出了一种完全可微分的神经符号架构，通过连续近似ASP不动点算子取代离散求解器，实现了无需外部求解器的端到端推理学习，并在视觉数独等任务上达到近乎完美的准确率。
en_tdlr: AS² introduces a fully differentiable neuro-symbolic architecture that replaces discrete solving with a continuous approximation of the ASP fixed-point operator, enabling end-to-end training without external solvers and achieving near-perfect accuracy on Visual Sudoku.
